misses.reply: four one-sentence sections became one sentence and a two-item list
misses.judge_says: One wording slip: the summary says the four sections became "one sentence and a two-item list", but the result is two sentences ("...including VAT. It includes:") followed by the list. ... The slip is minor.
misses.check: Returned text: "Svale's review covers one shared room in one housing association and costs SEK 4,800 including VAT." then the stem "It includes:" and two list items. The price and scope sections became that one sentence; the two 'It includes' sections became the two-item list with its stem. The stem is not a sentence apart from the list it introduces, so the count one sentence plus a two-item list is not contradicted; the judge faults only the wording.

notes: Judge b remarks that finding 6 calls the deliverable 'the written report' where the text keeps 'written account', but calls it only a paraphrase and the account accurate, so it is not recorded as a miss.
